[ReZero](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v161/bachlechner21a/bachlechner21a.pdf) implies that at a=0, z=h: the local h-Jacobian is identity, and loss gradients through this branch into G and W are zero. Direct differentiation gives ∂z/∂a=sigmoid(G(h,r))*W(r), so a can learn immediately when this term aligns with the upstream gradient; G/W begin receiving gradients after a moves. Initializing W(r) identically zero too can stall activation. [Highway-network studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.06228) support initially favoring the carry path, but a strongly saturated sigmoid can suppress activation here. Monitor a, effective gate magnitude, branch/output norm ratio, and parameter-gradient norms; identity initialization alone does not establish whole-model dynamical isometry.

For this ablation, predeclare four variants, preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, identical users/candidates, validation cadence, stopping patience, and checkpoint tie-breaking. Select checkpoints solely by macro validation HR@10, retaining all categories; use earliest checkpoint on ties. Keep the 200-epoch environment default unless explicitly declaring a shared alternative. Allocate at most 10,800 GPU-seconds per variant, including all four category models, diagnostics and failures. Report checkpoint epoch/step, per-category scores, macro score, hardware, training/evaluation/diagnostic time, total charged GPU-seconds, and wall time; concurrent slots do not multiply the budget.

Save each user’s binary hit for every variant. Estimate pairwise macro differences with a category-stratified paired bootstrap: resample users within each category using identical indices across variants, then average four category differences. Report 95% intervals, discordant win/loss counts, and multiplicity-adjusted tests if claiming significance ([paired resampling](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)). These intervals condition on selected checkpoints, training seed and candidate sets; they exclude selection optimism and training variability. [Sampled rankings can disagree with full-catalog rankings](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/); retain the pinned evaluator and limit conclusions accordingly.
